name: Red's Major Power Tier List
subject: major-powers
methodology: Transcribed from the five-part Red's Major Power Tier List by Spirit Island Archive, from yt-dlp auto-generated captions (scripts/fetch-transcripts.mjs). Each part covers an announced band: Part 1 (dHe0_n86nq4) F and D, Part 2 (rkuXUmf7kpM) C, Part 3 (Hc3bLAkiO5o) B, Part 4 (Olm9L9CnHfc) A, Part 5 (Hnm_rD4ziRc) S. The two [OUTDATED]-titled major power videos in the same playlist are superseded and were deliberately not ingested. The captions carry no section boundaries and the reviewer back-references other bands mid-section, so every rating here was read off the transcript section the card is actually discussed in rather than inferred from proximity to a spoken tier letter. All 78 major powers are rated. One needed care: the source rates Vengeance of the Dead twice - the base printing at D in Part 1, and 'the exploratory version' at A in Part 4 - while power-cards.json carries a single card of that name. The tie was broken by reading the card image this app itself ships (images/cards/major/vengeance_of_the_dead.webp), which shows 3 fear and '1 Damage per building/dahan destroyed': that is the base printing, matching Part 1's description. Hence D. If the card dataset is ever rebuilt from a newer source that ships the exploratory art instead, this key becomes A and must be re-checked.
